next_question.rationale: The biggest gap is created->confirmed (lost 87,511, share_of_prev 0.3862; overall created->confirmed conversion 0.6138). Cuts already show a large, high-volume weakness in the 'instant' trigger (entered 181,651 -> converted 94,141, rate 0.5183) versus near-perfect conversion for 'pd_erx_consultation' (entered 44,964 -> converted 44,963, rate 1.0), and scheduling shows scheduled bookings convert worse (scheduled entered 15,592 -> converted 6,593, rate 0.4228) than walk_ins (entered 211,023 -> converted 132,511, rate 0.6279). Hour-of-day also shows evening/hour pockets with low confirm rates (e.g., hour 21: entered 13,847 -> converted 7,244, rate 0.5231; hour 22: entered 11,367 -> converted 5,121, rate 0.4505), consistent with timing/queueing problems. Cut by delivery_channel next to test whether specific channels (e.g., mobile app vs web vs other channels) concentrate the low-converting instant/scheduled volume and thus explain much of the 87,511 loss; if a particular delivery_channel shows materially lower created->confirmed conversion, confirm with a targeted experiment (e.g., channel-specific queue/availability messaging or capacity changes) measuring created->confirmed uplift.
